description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of task types within a study of generative AI’s use in journalism, specifically focusing on article and headline generation. The chart contains two slices representing different task types. A larger slice, colored red, is labeled “Article generation” and represents approximately 83.2% of the total. A smaller slice, colored yellow, is labeled “Headline generation” and represents approximately 16.8% of the total. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. There is no separate legend provided, and no slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or offsetting. The slices are arranged with the larger segment positioned first and proceeding clockwise to the smaller segment.
